title: Value-bearing token positions need bounds on the reported price and on its age, not just on quantity
content:
Two provisions do work no rate limit can. A.6.1.1.2.2.6.1.3.1.13.1.2.5.1 records the Maple syrupUSDC Max Exchange Rate as the call `setMaxExchangeRate(MAPLE_SYRUP_USDC, 1e6, 3e6)` — bounding the accepted exchange rate within a fixed range. A.6.1.1.2.2.6.1.3.1.14.1.4.1 sets a **Staleness Threshold** of seven days for the Tokenized Treasury Instances, which each name a dedicated Rate Provider contract (.14.1.2.2.3, .14.2.2.2.3).

The reason these are separate from the rate limits is structural. Grove's holdings in syrupUSDC, JTRSY and BUIDL are yield-bearing claims whose value comes from a *reported* rate, not from the token count. `maxAmount` bounds how many units can move; it says nothing about whether each unit is worth what the feed claims. A compromised or buggy rate provider can therefore inflate the apparent value of a position, or misprice a redemption, without any quantity limit registering a breach.

So there are two distinct failure modes and one control for each: **corruption** of the rate, bounded by a hard floor and ceiling on the accepted value; and **staleness** of the rate, bounded by a maximum accepted age. A price can be wrong by being manipulated or by simply being old, and neither bound catches the other.

The seven-day threshold is the notable calibration. It concedes that a tokenized treasury fund's NAV updates on a business rhythm rather than a block rhythm, so a week-old mark must be treated as valid. The consequence is that these positions can be carried at a valuation up to seven days stale — acceptable for an instrument whose value moves slowly, and a real exposure if the underlying ever moves fast.

The generalizable rule: a control regime for value-bearing positions needs a volume bound, a price bound, and a freshness bound. Grove's schema puts the first in *Rate Limits* and the other two in the free-form off-chain and Instance-specific sections, where they are easier to overlook.
description: Grove pairs setMaxExchangeRate on syrupUSDC with a seven-day Staleness Threshold on treasury Rate Providers, because a quantity limit cannot detect a corrupted or stale valuation feed.
